Early-2000s Japanese independent film aesthetic — observational, naturalistic, documentary-influenced humanism. Medium: Shot on 16mm film with Aaton XTR Prod camera. Visible organic 16mm film grain (coarser in shadows, finer in highlights). Pronounced red-orange halation glow around bright metal highlights, sunlit reflective edges, and red painted railings. Natural film softness with limited resolution — explicitly NOT digitally sharp. Slight gate weave and early-2000s telecine character. Technical color: Pervasive warm green color cast covering the entire image — visible on skin tones, white shirts, cream skirts, gray pavement, and all neutral surfaces (the green is a global wash, not localized to plants). Warm amber-yellow highlights. Lifted shadows that retain color rather than crushing to black. Low contrast naturalistic summer afternoon light.
